title: Adrenaline Hormone
description: A new chance to survive deadly attacks! or save your pets from death
body:
**Features:**

1. Adrenaline makes you faster, jump higher, break faster, and a little resistant but, you get hungry!

2. You get Adrenaline Hormone when you/pets are about to die.

3. Small chance of not having Adrenaline Hormone.

4. You hear heartbeats. The lower your health, the faster you hear heartbeats!

5. Adrenaline cooldown can be viewed when you open the inventory.

6. prevents 1 hit kill, you will have half a heart and a chance to survive! ( 20% chance to not survive )

7. You get notified when your pet is about to die, also you get Adrenaline Hormone.



That's it. I hope my mod was useful for you!
